top.description: Player 1 background (Luffy + Zoro). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A detailed 2D anime illustration in the classic Toei One Piece style, square format 1:1. A single continuous, seamless, and unified landscape of the wooden deck of the Thousand Sunny ship against a bright tropical turquoise sea under a clear blue sky, spanning the entire width. On the left side of this same deck stands Monkey D. Luffy in his red open vest, blue shorts, and straw hat in a dynamic fighting stance, surrounded by a faint crackling white energy aura. On the right side of this same deck stands Roronoa Zoro, surrounded by a green flame-like sword aura, wielding three katanas. Both characters are naturally integrated into the same single-picture scenery and are drawn slightly smaller to fit entirely within the frame with a safe margin from the outer edges. The center of the deck is empty and clean. No split screen, no vertical dividers, no black bars, no empty black columns, no black panels. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, cropped characters, split screen, black bars, vertical dividers, black columns, black panels

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Luffy vs Kaido jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A stunning and epic 2D anime scene of a card match in the classic One Piece style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Two characters are seated properly and facing each other across a stone battlefield table on the stormy rooftop of Onigashima, playing a game of Magic. On the left, Monkey D. Luffy (Wano outfit) sits upright, looking intensely focused at his cards. On the right, Kaido in his human-beast form sits facing him, studying his own cards. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, a detailed Magic: The Gathering battlefield is laid out: rows of fantasy cards, with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degree angle to show they are tapped, alongside neat deck libraries and graveyard piles. The background is an epic storm with crackling red lightning and dark clouds swirling around the colossal skull dome. Vibrant cel-shading, dynamic shadows. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
